senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to move around (cmp. סחר),] to be a stranger, sojourn, dwell.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 36b:17">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>גֹרֹא שגָֹּרֹ וכ׳</he> he is named Gera (<cite ref="Genesis 46:21">Gen. XLVI, 21</cite>), because he (Joseph) dwells in exile; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 96b">Yeb. 96ᵇ</cite> is it possible <he>לָגּוּר וכ׳ בשני</he> to dwell (simultaneously) in two worlds? <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:11">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01224"><he>ג״ר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 301:3-4">Sifré Deut. 301</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 26:5">Deut. XXVI, 5</cite>) <he>מלמד … להשתקע אלא לָגוּר שם</he> it proves that he (Jacob) did not go down to be permanently settled, but only to sojourn there; a. fr.—Denom. <cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of גֵּר) to make a proselyte, to initiate into the Jewish faith.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 12:5">Gen. XII, 5</cite> ‘the souls which they had made’) <he>אלו הגרים שגִּיְּירוּ</he> that means the proselytes they had made.
<cite ref="Genesis 12:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מי שמקרב … ומְגַיְּירוֹ וכ׳</he> whoever befriends a gentile and effects his conversion, is considered as though he had created him.
Sabb. 31ᵃ גַּיְּירֵנִי וכ׳ make me a Jew with the condition &c.; a. fr. [For גִּיֵּיר to dress with lime, v. גִּיר.]
<cite ref="Berakhot 57b:20">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>עתידים להִתְגַּיֵּיר</he> they will adopt the Jewish faith.
<cite ref="Yevamot 47b:5">Yeb. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>גר שבא להתג׳</he> if a stranger comes (appears before Jewish authorities) desirous to become a Jew.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:3">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְגַּיְּירִין</he> shall ask to be admitted &c.; a. fr.
